responsibility: Declares the IO module API for character-based standard input, output, and error operations together with terminal-mode controls. It exposes the high-level standard-stream entry points and raw/buffered and echo mode switches that sit above FIO’s generic file handles and below higher-level text interfaces such as StdIO and StrIO.
same_name_distinction: This header simply declares the IO standard-stream and terminal-control entry points. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GIO.cc, it has no fd state table, no direct libc read/write loops, and no termios mode manipulation code.
